title: refactor(plugin-security): delete the position write-through and the row-only position backfill (C3 stage 7b)
body:
Refs #22975
Clause-②: no

C3 (#15204) stage 7b: delete the position write-through and the row-only position backfill. Stage 8 left both unreferenced, so this is dead-code deletion. It is the parallel half of 7a; 8-post follows once both have landed. #22975 stays open.

## What this changes

Stage 8 (#23222) stopped registering the `sys_position` row object, the `sys_position` data-door write-through and the row-only position backfill. Their modules stayed in the tree with no caller. This PR deletes them.

- **Deleted:** `position-write-through.ts` and `position-environment-backfill.ts`. Measured on `main` before this PR: no file imports `position-environment-backfill`, and only `catalog-reference-report.ts` imports `position-write-through` (for `POSITION_OBJECT` and `metadataDoorAcceptsPositionName`). The backfill is deleted rather than switched to core's `positionDefinitionFromRow`. That mapper (#22959) stays in core for the upgrade ceremony; no boot path calls it.
- **`PositionNameConflictError`** goes with the write-through, its only thrower (ruling Q4 → A). It was never exported from the package's entry.
- **The catalog reference report** (`catalog-reference-report.ts`) drops categories 4 and 5:
  - category 4: a position row with no definition;
  - category 5: a position name that several rows carry.
  
  It also drops the `posture` input, which only those two categories read. No composition registers `sys_position` after stage 8, so those categories could never read a row. Legacy position rows are the upgrade ceremony's to convert and report (ADR-0131 D10). The report still lists, per organization:
  - every assignment whose position the catalog does not resolve;
  - every grant whose permission set the catalog does not resolve;
  - every grant that names no permission set.
  
  The report is not exported. Seat answer Q1 → A.
- **Generated, regenerated with the repo's own tools:**
  - row 11b leaves `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx`;
  - the write-through's `UNTYPED_RECEIVERS` row leaves `scripts/tenant-audit-census.mjs`;
  - the tenant-audit census page and counts are regenerated with `node scripts/tenant-audit-census.mjs --write`, and the prose figures the gate names are updated (228 → 225 sites).

No export of `@objectstack/plugin-security`'s entry changes. The changeset is a `patch`, so no ADR-0087 marker is needed.

## Acceptance notes

- **Overlap with 7a.** 7a edits the same census, system-context and `security-plugin.ts` regions. Whichever PR lands second merges `main`, re-runs `node scripts/tenant-audit-census.mjs --write` and updates the census prose figures.
- **Not here:**
  - the comment sweep and the remaining catalog gates (8-post);
  - the catalog reference report's sixth class (8-post, director ruling #23229 → B).

## Verification

On head `8c7ee7f06a` (`main` `026391d5d8` merged in), unless noted:

- `plugin-security` unit suite: 188/188 files, 3,854 passed (45 skipped). Typecheck: exit 0. eslint on the changed files: exit 0.
- `check:tenant-audit-census` and `check:system-context-census`: exit 0.
- The derived gate sweep (`dispatch-gates --commands`): 114 derived and 114 run, all exit 0; `--ran` reconciles with 0 NOT-MEASURED and 0 UNRUN. This was measured on `05dee10c89`, the head before the last merge of `main`, whose five commits touch none of these files.
- The three symbol-anchor sweeps (adr, scripts, spec-docblock): exit 0.
- `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` on a full build (74/74 tasks): exit 0.
- `check:platform-checklist`: exit 1 with 8 reds. The same 8 reds appear on `main` (they are pre-existing).
- Dogfood: 254 files passed (1 skipped), 2,106 tests passed.
- CLI integration tier (`--project integration`): 119/119 files, 1,036 tests passed.
- objectui pinned sibling: no export of `@objectstack/plugin-security`'s entry changes, so nothing the console imports moves. CI's Console Pin Gate covers it.
